name: acp-harnesses
description: Switch Kiro Crew between any ACP-speaking coding agent — Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Codex CLI — from a provider picker in the dashboard, using your own local installs. Registers each harness at gateway startup, speaks each one's ACP dialect, injects a provider + model switcher into the dashboard UI, and corrects the in-chat model picker so it lists the active backend's models instead of kiro-cli's. Also restores Kiro Crew's MCP tools on the Claude backend, which the public build leaves empty.
author: mmkhatib
highlights: One picker: every harness's models listed in the dashboard's OWN model dropdown
Picking 'Gemini CLI › gemini-2.5-pro' switches backend AND model in one click
Switch applies in-process — no Kiro Crew restart
Runs your own local install of each harness — nothing is bundled or downloaded
No file patching: patches in-process at startup, so Kiro Crew updates cannot wipe it
Restores Kiro Crew MCP tools (cron, spawn, monitor) on the Claude backend
Refuses to register rather than half-apply if Kiro Crew's internals move
_ui_note: There is deliberately no ui.pages entry. A third-party page IS routed by the SPA but renders its 'Agent-only app' placeholder — entryPoint/mountFunction appear nowhere in the shipped bundle (verified 2026-09-09), so an app cannot supply page content that way. As of 2.1.0 the app renders NO UI of its own either: it injects a script into the SPA shell (see shell.py) that intercepts /api/models and the slot-model POST, so the harnesses appear as entries in the dashboard's own model picker. Intercepting the data layer instead of grafting DOM is what survives React reconciles and build-hashed class names.

harnesses.label: Claude Code
harnesses._models_note: Verified by direct ACP handshake against claude-agent-acp v0.70.0: session/new returns NO 'models' key, and configOptions[id=model] accepts exactly default | sonnet | claude-fable-5[1m] | opus | haiku. 'opus' is Opus 5. The CLI-style name 'claude-opus-5' is NOT accepted here and yields -32603. claude-fable-5[1m] is left out of the picker because the bracketed form risks tripping the canonical-key guard in _model_rejected_reason; set it via config.json if you want it.

harnesses.label: Codex CLI
harnesses._note: Codex CLI does not speak ACP natively; it needs an adapter. Install one (e.g. agentclientprotocol/codex-acp) so 'codex-acp' is on PATH, then set enabled=true. Off by default so the picker only offers harnesses that can actually start.

_config_note: harnesses, inject_mcp_servers and inject_ui are TOP-LEVEL on purpose. Kiro Crew collects every unknown top-level manifest key into AppManifest.extra and passes exactly that dict to the hook as ctx.config. Nesting them under a 'config' key would land them at ctx.config['config'] and the hook would silently fall back to its defaults with nothing logged.
useCases: Route Kiro Crew sessions through a local Claude Code, Gemini CLI or Codex CLI install instead of kiro-cli.
Switch provider and model from the dashboard instead of hand-editing config.json.
configuration: Enable and trust the app, then restart Kiro Crew ONCE so the startup hook runs. After that every harness appears in the normal chat model picker as 'Provider › model', and switching between them needs no further restart. On Windows also set agent.sandbox_allow_unsandboxed_exec=true so the harness subprocess may spawn.
